modules.label: 01 先组装 肩俯仰模块

steps.title: 准备连续固定座
steps.note: 固定输入握持座；清理入口和完整六角窝。此模块先在台面单独组装。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: NL3
steps.note: NL3 尼龙端先进入座深处，金属端朝入口；完整六角窝止转。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: W3
steps.note: 7×3.2×0.5 薄反力垫贴锁母金属端。不可换成 O22 的 9×3.2×0.8。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: W4
steps.note: 9×4.3×0.8 支承垫，给大垫内孔提供金属跨接。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: W6L
steps.note: 18×6.4×1.5 大平垫放进圆形浅座；这片金属大垫是轴向挡止件，不是普通可省略垫片。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 准备压盖、两颗锁母并装到固定座
steps.note: 在压盖尚未装上时，将两颗 NL3 从前侧放入完整六角窝，尼龙朝螺钉将露出的前侧。托住锁母，再将压盖罩住已放好的 18 mm 大平垫；不得把大平垫遗漏。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 压盖螺钉头下 W3
steps.note: 每边一片 7×3.2×0.5；从固定座后侧轴向放入。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 锁住防脱压盖：M3×16
steps.note: 整根螺钉从后侧装入，用 2.5 mm 内六角拧入已捕获 NL3。两边交替贴合，检查尖端完全穿过尼龙；这里只锁压盖，不调关节摩擦。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 压盖螺钉头下 W3
steps.note: 每边一片 7×3.2×0.5；从固定座后侧轴向放入。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 锁住防脱压盖：M3×16
steps.note: 整根螺钉从后侧装入，用 2.5 mm 内六角拧入已捕获 NL3。两边交替贴合，检查尖端完全穿过尼龙；这里只锁压盖，不调关节摩擦。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: FW4
steps.note: 内侧 12×4.3×1 摩擦垫，光滑面朝打印转子。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 肩俯仰转子 / 外展固定叉
steps.note: 将完整输出骨杆沿轴线套入。先前已经锁住的压盖留在固定座上；转子细颈进入盖孔，转子不得压住盖的环唇。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: FW4
steps.note: 外侧 12×4.3×1 摩擦垫，光滑面朝打印转子。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: A8
steps.note: 本关节 4 片：每 2 片同向套叠为一组，两组的内孔凸缘相对，构成并联×2、串联×2。 由靠转子的一组开始，依本步件号顺序放入。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: A8
steps.note: 本关节 4 片：每 2 片同向套叠为一组，两组的内孔凸缘相对，构成并联×2、串联×2。 由靠转子的一组开始，依本步件号顺序放入。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: A8
steps.note: 本关节 4 片：每 2 片同向套叠为一组，两组的内孔凸缘相对，构成并联×2、串联×2。 由靠转子的一组开始，依本步件号顺序放入。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: A8
steps.note: 本关节 4 片：每 2 片同向套叠为一组，两组的内孔凸缘相对，构成并联×2、串联×2。 由靠转子的一组开始，依本步件号顺序放入。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: W4
steps.note: 头下 9×4.3×0.8 平垫。 从骨杆两肋间的侧窗送入，再向关节推到位，见分段动画；不要从远端硬顶过叉桥。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: AX4
steps.note: Φ4×8／M3×6 肩钉整根从中心装入通道穿入；3 mm 内六角。先正常旋入金属牙，再通过尼龙锁固段；不要用肩部顶住小孔垫片代替弹簧预紧。先低预紧检查转动，后调保持力。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.

steps.title: 检查预紧、锁固与防脱
steps.note: 压盖的两颗螺钉均已锁紧后，托住骨杆轻推/拉，确认大平垫被前环唇与后座两面捕获。四片碟簧总高先取1.8 mm，工作区间1.7～2.0 mm。 不压平碟簧；尖端露出完整牙，记录见证线。
steps.animation_scope: Nominal assembly at zero adjustable angles; movement is an illustration of the reported module path.
